stories.title: Recovery fund set up for Lexington County deputy shot at Jamil Temple gun show
stories.summary: Deputy Eugene Hammill has had multiple surgeries since the Nov. 14 shooting. Organizers say all money raised will go directly to him.

stories.title: Breast cancer in men is rare but real. A Lexington Health nurse explains the warning signs
stories.summary: For men, the main sign is usually a lump, and it may be easier to find than in women. Family history matters, too.

stories.title: Highway 321 closed in Gaston near Ball Park Road for active incident, police say
stories.summary: Gaston police are asking drivers to avoid the area. Here are the detours for drivers heading north toward Cayce and south on Highway 321.

stories.title: Lower Richland residents report foul smell around Garners Ferry Road, but the source is still a mystery
stories.summary: People have compared it to sewage, manure and a landfill. Columbia Water says it isn’t aware of any sewage spills in the area.

stories.title: South Carolina unemployment rate drops to 3.9%, its lowest since April 2024
stories.summary: The rate has fallen eight months in a row, and a record 2.58 million South Carolinians are working. The national rate is 4.1%.

stories.title: Pedestrian dies after hit-and-run at Farrow and Hardscrabble roads in Richland County, troopers say
stories.summary: A pickup truck and a second vehicle hit the pedestrian early Friday on Farrow Road. The driver of the second vehicle left the scene, troopers said.

stories.title: Two die after pickup truck runs off I-26, hits tree in Newberry County, troopers say
stories.summary: The Dodge Ram caught fire after hitting a tree near the Jalapa Road exit Thursday afternoon. The crash backed up eastbound traffic past the exit.

stories.title: South Carolina prisons cleared to jam contraband cellphones after FCC vote
stories.summary: An inmate with a smuggled phone ordered a hit on South Carolina prison officer Robert Johnson in 2010. Now the FCC will let state prisons jam those phones.

stories.title: Richland County approves zoning change for up to 147 homes along Koon Road
stories.summary: Richland County Council unanimously approved a zoning change allowing up to 147 homes on 24.6 acres along Koon Road despite residents' flooding concerns.

stories.title: Irmo Fire District seeks firing of Columbia’s top fire officials in James Muller lawsuit
stories.summary: The offer also demands public apologies and about $40,000 in legal fees. The city of Columbia called the demand to remove two fire leaders egregious.

stories.title: Bill named for Javeayah Harris would change how South Carolina investigates child abuse
stories.summary: The Aiken County 4-year-old’s remains were found more than 100 miles from home. The proposal would add checks before abuse cases can be closed.

stories.title: Veterans went to an Aiken clinic for help. What the VA got billed for ended in a federal conviction
stories.summary: Prosecutors say some bills were for therapy the clinic had no way to provide. They counted more than 66,000 fraudulent bills in all.
